identification.description: A milky-latex shrub with thick grey-green leaves; waxy crown-like flowers are distinctive.
identification_points: Leaves are opposite, thick and broadly elliptic.
Flowers are white to pink/purple with a central crown.
Fruit is a paired follicle; seeds are flat and silky-haired.

therapeutics.dose: Mula (root) 1–3 g for kwatha; Patra churna 250–750 mg; Kanda twak churna 0.5–1 g
therapeutics.precautions: Upavisha. Ksheera (latex) and other parts are used internally only after Shodhana (purification); the raw latex is a strong irritant to skin, eyes and the gut. Do not exceed API doses; use only under qualified supervision.
therapeutics.contraindications: Contraindicated in pregnancy and lactation and in children.
